description: This file is a script for running batched tests using Vitest within a project. It handles command-line arguments, resolves test plans for specified extensions, and spawns child processes to execute tests accordingly.

methods.name: runVitestBatch
methods.description: Runs a batch of Vitest tests in a child process with specified parameters.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: parseExtensionIds
methods.description: Parses extension IDs and passthrough arguments from command-line arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main execution function that processes arguments, resolves test plans, and executes test batches.
